$(l)NAME(S), RANKS(S), AND STATION OF OFFENDING PERSON(S)$()$(br)Country bumpkins,$(br)the middle of nowhere,$(br)ugh... what's even the point$(br2)$(l)BODY OF REPORT$()$(br2)I guess this thing will suffice to vent my frustrations.$(br2)Another gaggle of bumbling mud-shovellers showed up today offering an outsized, fly-ridden pile of warts at my feet.

As if that's sufficient to glorify our illustrious empire. I'd almost be compelled to offer a second chance to the small folk if they weren't so frightfully uncouth. Honestly, what does the queen see in trying to bring discipline to these rabble? I could think of a myriad of better uses for them than demanding a tribute of horse droppings.

Why should I be appointed to this backwater, anyhow? My calling is that of a leader. A ruler. A beacon of culture and refinement. The Great Civilizer. The architect of a new golden era. The sole arbiter of the future of Mobius.$(br2)Alas, here I remain. Entertained only by the antics of plow-pushing clodhoppers and the mindless oafs who keep them at bay.

But I will never lose sight of my purpose. My glorious ascent will become the song of the ages. Tales of my exploits the stuff of legends. With unclouded eyes, a superior intellect, and a mastery of the magical arts, my chapter in the history of the realm has only just begun.$(br2)I WILL wear that crown someday. I suppose that means I'll have to marry the queen. Ah well. At least she's beautiful...

The road to power is never straight, it seems.$(br2)$(l)NAME AND RANK OF COMMANDING OFFICER$()$(br)Governor Cassian Enzo Moxley, First of His Name$(br2)$(l)DISCIPLINARY RECOMMENDATION$()$(br)Don't underestimate one who is born for greatness. To do so will surely prove a grave folly...
